items.name: Ice Golem
items.description: The Ice Golem has a chilling personality and absolutely zero sense of humour. He frosts over everything he touches, freezes his surroundings when destroyed and ices up when talked to at a party. On defense his freeze effect is smaller and has a shorter duration.

items.name: Meteor Golem
items.description: From the cosmos, to your army! This lob-loving duo will throw themselves at anything for up-close damage. When separated, Meteormites will attack nearby targets or find a friend to form a Meteor Golem!

items.name: Miner
items.description: He digs underground, passing through Walls to attack your target buildings!

superTroop.name: Super Miner
superTroop.description: Armed with a powerful drill and a magnificent moustache, Super Miner is ready to undermine any rival Village!

items.name: Minion
items.description: This terror of the skies was born out of Dark Elixir. Undetectable by the Seeking Air Mine, Minions materialize with ease, but are fragile in our world.

superTroop.name: Super Minion
superTroop.description: Super Minion's big forehead isn't just for show: sniping enemy defenses from a safe distance is simply a brainy move! Especially when you've grown too big to avoid Seeking Air Mines.

items.name: P.E.K.K.A
items.description: Is P.E.K.K.A a knight? A samurai? A robot? No one knows! P.E.K.K.A's armor absorbs even the mightiest of blows.

items.name: Root Rider
items.description: This earth warrior is so in tune with nature she doesn't need to walk herself. Riding into battle atop a tough tree root, Root Rider can smash through Walls and slam Defenses into dust.

items.name: Ruin Witch
items.description: After Ruin Witch lost her powers in an unusual alchemy accident, Master Builder crafted an ingenious invention to keep her summoning pursuits alive. The Debrisbuster 5000 vacuums the remains of fallen buildings and spits out battle-ready Ruin Knights.

ruinKnight.name: Ruin Knight
ruinKnight.description: Please read the manual before operating the Debrisbuster 5000. Its recycled warriors are great for the environment, but will leave the immediate area in ruins.

items.name: Thrower
items.description: This powerful pitcher has his eye on the prize! The Thrower hurls mighty spears from long range at enemies and Defenses. His secret? The strength lies in his fabulous facial hair!

items.name: Valkyrie
items.description: A master of the two-handed axe, this glorious warrior runs between nearby buildings and can shred several troops or buildings at once with her whirlwind blow!

superTroop.name: Super Valkyrie
superTroop.description: Not only are Super Valkyries superior to regular Valkyries in every way, they're also way more angry!

items.name: Wall Breaker
items.description: Nothing warms a Wall Breaker's cold and undead heart like blowing up walls. A squad of them will make way for your ground units, and they will do it with a BANG!

superTroop.name: Super Wall Breaker
superTroop.description: Who knew that rolling was so much superior to running? Super Wall Breakers use pre-ignited bombs that blow up under all circumstances! No more duds!

items.name: Witch
items.description: The Witch never fights alone, constantly raising dead warriors from past battles to lead her attacks. Upgraded Witches raise more skeletons at a time.

superTroop.name: Super Witch
superTroop.description: Focused magic creates focused results. Instead of summoning hordes of tiny Skeletons, Super Witch summons just one really big skeleton with very formidable bone density.

items.name: Wizard
items.description: The Wizard is a terrifying presence on the battlefield. Pair him up with some of his fellows and cast concentrated blasts of destruction on anything, land or sky!

superTroop.name: Super Wizard
superTroop.description: Super Wizard is positively charged with magical energy! He's either the smartest person in the room... or else he blows the whole room to bits.

items.name: Yeti
items.description: The heavy-hitting furry fellow digs cold weather and his Yetimite buddies. Hurt him, and you'll make the Yetimites real angry.

superTroop.name: Super Yeti
superTroop.description: This mysterious masked Yeti is charged up! His electrical little buddies spring into action when he takes damage and zap the closest Building to spark a devastating chain reaction!

items.name: Wall
items.description: Walls are great for keeping your village safe and your enemies in the line of fire.
